versions.changelog:
- Integrates with Amazing Marvin through the OOMOL `oo` CLI and server-side credentials.
- Supports reading tasks, projects, categories, labels, scheduled items, due items, and completed items.
- Creates tasks and projects with scheduling, labels, notes, priorities, and title shortcuts.
- Marks tasks complete through the experimental completion API.
- Fetches live action schemas before executing requests and requires confirmation for state-changing actions.

Source: `oomol-lab/skills@e0d34d9`
